rows.plotDescription: 粉色背景，中心为一个白色巴洛克风格的椭圆镜框，框内有粉色“DIOR ADDICT THE NEW LIP GLOW OIL”文字。
rows.narrativeIntent: 开场展示品牌与产品系列名称，奠定粉色、优雅、女性化的视觉基调。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：快节奏、时尚的电子鼓点与女声哼唱；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Dior Addict logo inside a white ornate baroque oval mirror frame, pastel pink background, luxury product typography, clean and minimalist aesthetic, 8k resolution.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Static shot of the logo within the frame, soft shadows subtly shifting on the pink background.

rows.plotDescription: 一张铺满粉色花瓣的餐桌，摆放着粉色果冻、蛋糕和唇釉产品，画面快速下压俯冲。
rows.narrativeIntent: 营造一种梦幻、甜美的奢华派对氛围，展现产品与生活方式的关联。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 明亮的高调照明，突出粉色调
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：节奏持续增强；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Top down view of a luxury table covered in pink flower petals, pink jelly cakes, and Dior lip gloss bottles, festive and dreamy atmosphere, vibrant pink tones, high fashion photography.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Fast camera dive down towards the center of the table, petals slightly moving from the wind of the camera movement.

rows.plotDescription: 金智秀（Jisoo）的近景，背景是整齐排列的粉色香水瓶，她眼神迷人，妆容精致，眼角有星星贴纸。
rows.narrativeIntent: 全球大使登场，将产品美学具象化为明星的魅力。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 柔和的三点式人像布光，皮肤质感通透
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：快节奏流行节奏；人声/音效：人声歌词片段
rows.camera: 平视；景深：浅景深（背景香水瓶虚化）
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Close-up portrait of Jisoo (BLACKPINK), pink eye makeup with tiny stars, glossy pink lips, background of blurry pink perfume bottles, high-end fashion editorial style, 8k.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Jisoo looking into the camera with a subtle, confident expression, slight head tilt.

rows.plotDescription: Jisoo侧过头看着镜头，手中拿着唇釉。背景依然是甜美的粉色场景。
rows.narrativeIntent: 展示产品的使用姿态与明星的互动。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：快节奏节奏持续；人声/音效：歌词：'On a string...'
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Jisoo holding a Dior lip glow oil bottle near her face, pink aesthetic background with desserts, soft lighting, glamorous and sweet look, high-fashion campaign.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Jisoo turning her head to look at the lens, holding the product elegantly, background elements slightly shimmering.

rows.plotDescription: 手部特写，拿着唇釉在铺满花瓣的桌面上滑过。
rows.narrativeIntent: 强调动作的流畅感与派对的动感。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：重拍鼓点；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Close-up of a hand holding a pink Dior lip gloss moving across a table of pink flower petals, dynamic motion blur, luxury product shot.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: The hand moves quickly from right to left across the screen, flower petals scattering slightly.

rows.plotDescription: 唇部特写，展示正在涂抹粉色晶莹唇釉的过程，牙齿洁白。
rows.narrativeIntent: 直观展示产品的使用效果——高光、滋润与色彩。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 环形闪光灯感，突出唇釉的镜面折射
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：鼓点与人声交织；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Extreme macro shot of female lips applying shiny pink lip gloss, white teeth visible, wet reflective texture, high-detail skin and product texture.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: The lip gloss applicator glides over the bottom lip, leaving a trail of high-shine pink liquid.

rows.plotDescription: 唇釉瓶身特写，透出内部带有细闪的粉色液体，覆盖有“PH-ACTIVATED COLOUR”文字。
rows.narrativeIntent: 展示产品核心卖点：pH感应变色与闪耀质地。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 侧逆光，强调内部闪粉颗粒
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：音乐高潮点；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Macro shot of a Dior lip oil bottle, sparkling pink liquid inside, 'PH-ACTIVATED COLOUR' text overlay, luxury branding, shimmering particles.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Camera zooms slowly into the bottle, the liquid inside glimmers as light hits the glitter.

rows.plotDescription: Jisoo手持唇釉，唇釉瓶盖反射出光芒。特写镜头。
rows.narrativeIntent: 品牌代言人与产品的再次同框，强化关联。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 柔美的人像光，瓶盖金属质感强烈
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：女声：'I want to feel...'；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Jisoo close-up holding a silver Dior lip gloss bottle, metallic cap reflection, soft pink glow, high-end beauty photography.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Jisoo looks down then back up at the camera, holding the product steady.

rows.plotDescription: 微距拍摄粉色晶莹剔透的液体（果冻或唇釉）滑落，形态饱满。
rows.narrativeIntent: 感官诱惑，表现产品的质感与丰盈感。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 透射光，展现液体的透明度
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：急促鼓点；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Extreme macro of thick translucent pink liquid dripping, jelly-like texture, bright pink aesthetic, glossy and smooth surface.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: The pink liquid slowly flows downwards, showing heavy viscosity and high gloss.

rows.plotDescription: 创意陈列：一圈银色唇釉围绕着中间堆叠的红色晶莹圆珠，上方滴落粉色液体。
rows.narrativeIntent: 超现实主义的产品展示，强调产品的丰富性与诱人质感。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：动感节奏持续；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Creative arrangement of Dior lip gloss bottles in a circle around a mound of red translucent gel spheres, pink liquid dripping from above, surreal product photography.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Liquid drips onto the red spheres while the camera performs a subtle 360-degree rotation.

rows.plotDescription: 安雅·泰勒-乔伊（Anya Taylor-Joy）登场，银发蓝裙，坐在堆满唇釉和果冻的桌子后，身处华丽的粉色房间。
rows.narrativeIntent: 第二位代言人登场，展现不同风格的奢华与灵动感。
rows.lightingAndAtmosphere: 华丽的室内自然光感，营造经典美感
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：节奏感强烈；人声/音效：歌词：'I want to taste...'
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Anya Taylor-Joy with platinum blonde hair, light blue dress, sitting in a luxurious pink French salon, table full of pink Dior lip products, cinematic lighting, 8k.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Anya looks directly into the lens with a calm and mysterious gaze.

rows.plotDescription: Anya侧头近景特写，嘴里含着红色棒棒糖，看向镜头，眼角同样有星星贴纸。
rows.narrativeIntent: 呼应前一章节，体现俏皮与诱惑并存的特质。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：节奏持续；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Close-up of Anya Taylor-Joy biting a red lollipop, pink star stickers on face, playful expression, pink background, high fashion aesthetic.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Anya turns her face slightly towards the camera while holding the lollipop in her mouth.

rows.plotDescription: 银色Dior瓶盖的微距镜头，快速旋转并伴有光泽闪烁。
rows.narrativeIntent: 展现包装的精致工艺与金属质感。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：强力鼓点；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Macro shot of a silver Dior lip gloss cap with engraved logo, spinning rapidly, brilliant metallic reflections, luxury design.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: The metallic cap spins quickly on its axis, creating a blur of silver light.

rows.plotDescription: 唇部特写，展示涂抹后的透亮效果。
rows.narrativeIntent: 再次强调产品的妆效。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：歌词：'I want to feel...'；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Extreme close-up of glossy pink lips, mirror-like finish, high saturation pink, clean beauty look.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: Slight movement of the lips, a soft pout to show the light reflection.

rows.plotDescription: 粉色透明液体滴落在带有CD标志的透明球体上，画面标注“ULTRA SHINE”。
rows.narrativeIntent: 视觉化表达“极致亮泽”的核心功效。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：梦幻的合成器音效；人声/音效：无
rows.imageGenerationPrompt: Pink syrup-like liquid dripping over a glass sphere with 'CD' logo, 'ULTRA SHINE' text, crystal clear pink aesthetics, high-speed photography.
rows.videoMotionPrompt: The liquid slowly coats the sphere, creating a satisfying viscous flow.

rows.plotDescription: 多支唇釉产品和一支唇刷呈发射状或随机堆叠在一起。
rows.narrativeIntent: 多色号展示，表现产品线的丰富性。
rows.audioEffects: 背景音乐：快节奏收尾；人声/音效：无

rows.videoMotionPrompt: The items appear to drop or shift slightly in a rhythmic montage.

rows.plotDescription: 满屏粉色透明球体与唇釉瓶身混合滚动或静止陈列。
rows.narrativeIntent: 以极致的粉色视觉符号收尾，强化品牌记忆。

rows.visual_description: 粉色背景，中心为一个白色巴洛克风格的椭圆镜框，框内有粉色“DIOR ADDICT THE NEW LIP GLOW OIL”文字。
rows.content: 开场展示品牌与产品系列名称，奠定粉色、优雅、女性化的视觉基调。
rows.audio_music: 快节奏、时尚的电子鼓点与女声哼唱
rows.image_generation_prompt: Dior Addict logo inside a white ornate baroque oval mirror frame, pastel pink background, luxury product typography, clean and minimalist aesthetic, 8k resolution.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Static shot of the logo within the frame, soft shadows subtly shifting on the pink background.

rows.visual_description: 一张铺满粉色花瓣的餐桌，摆放着粉色果冻、蛋糕和唇釉产品，画面快速下压俯冲。
rows.content: 营造一种梦幻、甜美的奢华派对氛围，展现产品与生活方式的关联。
rows.lighting: 明亮的高调照明，突出粉色调
rows.image_generation_prompt: Top down view of a luxury table covered in pink flower petals, pink jelly cakes, and Dior lip gloss bottles, festive and dreamy atmosphere, vibrant pink tones, high fashion photography.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Fast camera dive down towards the center of the table, petals slightly moving from the wind of the camera movement.

rows.visual_description: 金智秀（Jisoo）的近景，背景是整齐排列的粉色香水瓶，她眼神迷人，妆容精致，眼角有星星贴纸。
rows.content: 全球大使登场，将产品美学具象化为明星的魅力。
rows.focal_depth: 浅景深（背景香水瓶虚化）
rows.lighting: 柔和的三点式人像布光，皮肤质感通透
rows.image_generation_prompt: Close-up portrait of Jisoo (BLACKPINK), pink eye makeup with tiny stars, glossy pink lips, background of blurry pink perfume bottles, high-end fashion editorial style, 8k.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Jisoo looking into the camera with a subtle, confident expression, slight head tilt.

rows.visual_description: Jisoo侧过头看着镜头，手中拿着唇釉。背景依然是甜美的粉色场景。
rows.content: 展示产品的使用姿态与明星的互动。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Jisoo holding a Dior lip glow oil bottle near her face, pink aesthetic background with desserts, soft lighting, glamorous and sweet look, high-fashion campaign.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Jisoo turning her head to look at the lens, holding the product elegantly, background elements slightly shimmering.

rows.visual_description: 手部特写，拿着唇釉在铺满花瓣的桌面上滑过。
rows.content: 强调动作的流畅感与派对的动感。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Close-up of a hand holding a pink Dior lip gloss moving across a table of pink flower petals, dynamic motion blur, luxury product shot.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The hand moves quickly from right to left across the screen, flower petals scattering slightly.

rows.visual_description: 唇部特写，展示正在涂抹粉色晶莹唇釉的过程，牙齿洁白。
rows.content: 直观展示产品的使用效果——高光、滋润与色彩。
rows.lighting: 环形闪光灯感，突出唇釉的镜面折射
rows.image_generation_prompt: Extreme macro shot of female lips applying shiny pink lip gloss, white teeth visible, wet reflective texture, high-detail skin and product texture.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The lip gloss applicator glides over the bottom lip, leaving a trail of high-shine pink liquid.

rows.visual_description: 唇釉瓶身特写，透出内部带有细闪的粉色液体，覆盖有“PH-ACTIVATED COLOUR”文字。
rows.content: 展示产品核心卖点：pH感应变色与闪耀质地。
rows.lighting: 侧逆光，强调内部闪粉颗粒
rows.image_generation_prompt: Macro shot of a Dior lip oil bottle, sparkling pink liquid inside, 'PH-ACTIVATED COLOUR' text overlay, luxury branding, shimmering particles.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Camera zooms slowly into the bottle, the liquid inside glimmers as light hits the glitter.

rows.visual_description: Jisoo手持唇釉，唇釉瓶盖反射出光芒。特写镜头。
rows.content: 品牌代言人与产品的再次同框，强化关联。
rows.lighting: 柔美的人像光，瓶盖金属质感强烈
rows.image_generation_prompt: Jisoo close-up holding a silver Dior lip gloss bottle, metallic cap reflection, soft pink glow, high-end beauty photography.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Jisoo looks down then back up at the camera, holding the product steady.

rows.visual_description: 微距拍摄粉色晶莹剔透的液体（果冻或唇釉）滑落，形态饱满。
rows.content: 感官诱惑，表现产品的质感与丰盈感。
rows.lighting: 透射光，展现液体的透明度
rows.image_generation_prompt: Extreme macro of thick translucent pink liquid dripping, jelly-like texture, bright pink aesthetic, glossy and smooth surface.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The pink liquid slowly flows downwards, showing heavy viscosity and high gloss.

rows.visual_description: 创意陈列：一圈银色唇釉围绕着中间堆叠的红色晶莹圆珠，上方滴落粉色液体。
rows.content: 超现实主义的产品展示，强调产品的丰富性与诱人质感。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Creative arrangement of Dior lip gloss bottles in a circle around a mound of red translucent gel spheres, pink liquid dripping from above, surreal product photography.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Liquid drips onto the red spheres while the camera performs a subtle 360-degree rotation.

rows.visual_description: 安雅·泰勒-乔伊（Anya Taylor-Joy）登场，银发蓝裙，坐在堆满唇釉和果冻的桌子后，身处华丽的粉色房间。
rows.content: 第二位代言人登场，展现不同风格的奢华与灵动感。
rows.lighting: 华丽的室内自然光感，营造经典美感
rows.image_generation_prompt: Anya Taylor-Joy with platinum blonde hair, light blue dress, sitting in a luxurious pink French salon, table full of pink Dior lip products, cinematic lighting, 8k.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Anya looks directly into the lens with a calm and mysterious gaze.

rows.visual_description: Anya侧头近景特写，嘴里含着红色棒棒糖，看向镜头，眼角同样有星星贴纸。
rows.content: 呼应前一章节，体现俏皮与诱惑并存的特质。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Close-up of Anya Taylor-Joy biting a red lollipop, pink star stickers on face, playful expression, pink background, high fashion aesthetic.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Anya turns her face slightly towards the camera while holding the lollipop in her mouth.

rows.visual_description: 银色Dior瓶盖的微距镜头，快速旋转并伴有光泽闪烁。
rows.content: 展现包装的精致工艺与金属质感。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Macro shot of a silver Dior lip gloss cap with engraved logo, spinning rapidly, brilliant metallic reflections, luxury design.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The metallic cap spins quickly on its axis, creating a blur of silver light.

rows.visual_description: 唇部特写，展示涂抹后的透亮效果。
rows.content: 再次强调产品的妆效。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Extreme close-up of glossy pink lips, mirror-like finish, high saturation pink, clean beauty look.
rows.video_motion_prompt: Slight movement of the lips, a soft pout to show the light reflection.

rows.visual_description: 粉色透明液体滴落在带有CD标志的透明球体上，画面标注“ULTRA SHINE”。
rows.content: 视觉化表达“极致亮泽”的核心功效。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Pink syrup-like liquid dripping over a glass sphere with 'CD' logo, 'ULTRA SHINE' text, crystal clear pink aesthetics, high-speed photography.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The liquid slowly coats the sphere, creating a satisfying viscous flow.

rows.visual_description: 多支唇釉产品和一支唇刷呈发射状或随机堆叠在一起。
rows.content: 多色号展示，表现产品线的丰富性。
rows.image_generation_prompt: Collage of Dior lip oil bottles and an applicator brush, overlapping in a dynamic composition, different shades of pink and coral.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The items appear to drop or shift slightly in a rhythmic montage.

rows.visual_description: 满屏粉色透明球体与唇釉瓶身混合滚动或静止陈列。
rows.content: 以极致的粉色视觉符号收尾，强化品牌记忆。
rows.image_generation_prompt: A sea of pink translucent pearls and Dior lip glow oil bottles filling the frame, pink-on-pink aesthetic, luxury texture, 8k.
rows.video_motion_prompt: The spheres subtly roll and settle amongst the product bottles.
